@graph.name: SuperchargeBrowser
@graph.description: Chrome and Edge extensions for tab suspension, ad blocking, vertical tabs, workspaces, and per-tab audio control. Zero telemetry, 100% local. Featured & Verified Publisher on Chrome Web Store.

@graph.name: SuperchargePerformance
@graph.description: Tab suspender + ad blocker + RAM dashboard for Chrome and Edge. Suspends inactive tabs using chrome.tabs.discard(), blocks trackers with 186,000+ declarativeNetRequest rules from 22 sources. Zero telemetry, 100% local.
@graph.operatingSystem: Chrome 146+, Edge, Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS
featureList: 25+ auto-protected web apps (productivity, media, and calls)
@graph.permissions: Zero telemetry. Zero outbound network requests. All data stored locally in chrome.storage.local.

@graph.name: SuperchargeNavigation
@graph.description: Vertical tabs + named workspaces + command bar + session time-travel for Chrome. Uses Chrome's side panel API. 50 auto-snapshots every 5 minutes. Alt+K command bar. Zero telemetry, 100% local.
@graph.operatingSystem: Chrome 146+, Edge, Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS
featureList: Vertical tab sidebar (Chrome side panel API)
In-page sidebar (vertical tabs inside any page; dedicated tab on Chrome-protected pages)
Alt+K command bar (tabs, bookmarks, history, web search)
Alt+G smart tab grouping by domain
Super Drag (drag links to open in bg/fg)
@graph.permissions: Zero telemetry. Zero outbound network requests. All data stored locally in chrome.storage.local.

@graph.name: SuperchargeAudio
@graph.description: Per-tab volume boost up to 600%, 10-band EQ (32Hz–16kHz, ±12dB), Smart Mute, per-site memory, 8D audio, Bauer crossfeed, and stereo width control for Chrome and Edge. Zero telemetry, 100% local. Available on the Chrome Web Store and Microsoft Edge Add-ons.
@graph.operatingSystem: Microsoft Edge, Chrome, Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS
featureList: Per-tab volume boost up to 600% via Web Audio API GainNode
Smart Mute: silence all tabs except the audible one
Per-site memory: volume and EQ persist per domain
@graph.permissions: Zero telemetry. Permissions: storage, tabs, tabCapture, offscreen, host all_urls. No webRequest. All data stored locally in chrome.storage.local.

@graph.name: SuperchargeCapture
@graph.description: Screen recorder and full-page screenshot tool for Chrome and Edge. Records a tab with no screen-picker dialog, or a window or the whole screen; captures full-page and region screenshots. Built-in editor with auto-zoom, annotation, and trim. Zero telemetry, 100% local, no watermark, requests no website access by default.
@graph.operatingSystem: Microsoft Edge, Chrome, Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS
featureList: Tab, window, and screen recording with no screen-picker dialog for tab capture
Built-in editor: annotation, automatic zoom on clicks, smoothed cursor, trim
Export a recording as GIF, MP4, or WebM; export a screenshot or full page as PDF
Optional webcam bubble with on-device background blur
Save as a file download, or upload to your own Google Drive
@graph.permissions: Zero telemetry. Requests no website access by default. Recording continuously across page navigations is a separate opt-in. Files never pass through SuperchargeBrowser servers; Google Drive uploads go to the user's own account.
